facts.title: Watergate break-in — 1972
facts.text: The Watergate break-in occurred on 17 June 1972 at the Democratic National Committee headquarters in Washington, D.C.

facts.title: Nixon resignation — 1974
facts.text: President Richard Nixon resigned on 9 August 1974 following the Watergate scandal.

facts.title: Zero-sum game — definition
facts.text: A zero-sum game is a situation in which one party’s gain is matched by another party’s loss, leaving a net result of zero.

facts.title: Persona non grata — diplomatic meaning
facts.text: Persona non grata means an unwelcome person; in diplomatic practice, a state may bar a diplomat’s entry or censure a diplomat already resident for conduct unbecoming of diplomatic status.

facts.title: Ambassador — diplomatic role
facts.text: An ambassador is a senior diplomatic representative of one state to another state or international organization.
